div.head: Af 19
div.ab: XVII. Gif hwa his wæpn oðrum læne, ðæt he mon mid ofslea, hy moton hy gesomnian, gif hi willað, to ðæm were.
XVII. Gif hwa his wæpnes oðrum onlæne, þæt he mon mid ófslea, hie moton hie gesomnian, gif hie willað, to þam were.
Si quis alteri prestet arma sua in occisione alicuius, licet eis, si uelint, weram eius (mortui) coniectare.
{XVII} Gif hwa his wæpnes oðrum onlæne, þæt he mon mid ófslea, hie moton hie gesomnian gif hie willað, to þam were.
If someone loans his weapon to another so that he can kill a man, they may combine to pay the wer if they want to.
If anyone lends a weapon to another [man], for the purpose of committing murder with it, they may, if they are willing to, combine to pay the wergeld.
If anyone lends his weapon to another that he may kill a man with it, they may, if they wish, join to pay the wergild.
Wenn einer einem anderen seine Waffe hinleiht, womit der einen Menschen erschlägt, so dürfen sie, wenn sie wollen, sich zusammenthun zur Wergeld[bezahlung].
If someone lends his weapon to another, with which the latter slays a person, they may, if they wish, join together for [payment of] the wergeld.

note.label: possibly influenced by
note.quote: a lender's liability for any blood spilt by the weapon loaned (n. 86: Af 19 – 19:3; Abt 18 – 20)
